title: LLM在硬件设计RTL编码中的失败与泛化
summary: 本文提出一种基于问题可解性的错误分类法，将LLM在硬件设计RTL编码中的失败分为语法、语义、可解功能和不可解功能四类。评估显示前沿模型在VerilogEval基准上初始通过率上限为90.8%，由不可解功能错误定义。研究发现对齐技术仅教会模型编译，重复采样可修补可解错误，但RTL编码能力受限于预训练知识，需更多研究模型推理而非对齐干预。
summary_en: This paper introduces an error taxonomy for LLM failures in hardware RTL coding, categorizing errors into syntactic, semantic, solvable functional, and unsolvable functional types. Evaluations show a 90.8% pass rate ceiling on VerilogEval, defined by unsolvable functional errors. Alignment only teaches compilation; RTL capacity is bounded by pretraining knowledge, requiring more reasoning research.
